text: Release 42 deployed. Five minutes later 5xx increased. Database pool was also near its limit.
Latency increased after a release, but memory stayed flat and upstream payment connections were reset repeatedly.
Authentication failures appeared after deployment, but the service logs show an expired token rather than a code regression.
Traffic increased, connection pool exhaustion followed, while the deployed version had no error-rate change in canary.
Memory climbed steadily across identical requests; deployment was unchanged for two hours before the OOM event.
